question: Why did gymnastics give up the perfect 10 in 2006?
answer: A ceiling on the score was a ceiling on the sport. Under a maximum of 10, a harder routine performed slightly less cleanly could lose to a safe one done perfectly. The new code split marks into an open-ended difficulty score, built up from zero, and an execution score that starts at 10 and falls.
move: Cap the reward and people stop attempting the hard thing.
